generate-icon-subset.description: Scans templates for icon usage, builds an offline subset, and wires it into the provider

add-icon.description: Adds an icon to the SSR offline subset via the dynamic icon manifest and regenerates it

list-sets.description: Lists Iconify icon sets from the catalog with search/category filters (read-only)

validate-icon.description: Validates that an icon reference is well-formed and that the set and icon actually exist

validate-set.description: Validates that a set prefix exists in the Iconify catalog and prints its metadata

skill.description: Regenerates the AI agent skill (.agents/skills/ngx-iconify-stack) in the target project
